title: Even bill split in cents with deterministic remainder
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (generation-v3 clean-authored stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer might flag the first people receiving an extra cent as unfair. With integer cents an exactly equal split is impossible when the total does not divide evenly; the contract bounds the difference to one cent, keeps the sum exact, and fixes the remainder order so results are reproducible.
